## Task: Add "Notify All Customers" feature to the Waitlist page

You need to modify `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` to add a "Notify All Customers" button that notifies ALL waiting customers across ALL ZIP codes in one click.

### IMPORTANT: Read the file first, then implement ALL of these changes:

### 1. Backend — New `notify-all` action intent

Add a new intent `"notify-all"` in the action function (after the existing `"notify-zip"` intent block). It should:
- Check Pro/Ultimate plan gate (same as existing bulk-notify: `PLAN_LIMITS[sub.planTier].maxWaitlist < UNLIMITED` → return error)
- Find ALL waiting entries for the shop: `db.waitlistEntry.findMany({ where: { shop, status: "waiting" }, select: { id: true, email: true, zipCode: true } })`
- If no entries found, return `{ action: "notify-all", emails: [], count: 0, zipBreakdown: [] }`
- Update all waiting entries to "notified": `db.waitlistEntry.updateMany({ where: { shop, status: "waiting" }, data: { status: "notified" } })`
- Build a zipBreakdown array: `[{ zipCode: string, count: number }]` from the found entries
- Collect all emails
- Return `{ action: "notify-all", emails: string[], count: number, zipBreakdown: { zipCode: string, count: number }[] }`

### 2. Frontend — State and handlers

Add these new state variables:
```typescript
const [notifyAllModalOpen, setNotifyAllModalOpen] = useState(false);
const [notifyAllResultModalOpen, setNotifyAllResultModalOpen] = useState(false);
const [notifyAllResult, setNotifyAllResult] = useState<{
  emails: string[];
  count: number;
  zipBreakdown: { zipCode: string; count: number }[];
} | null>(null);
const [copyAllSuccess, setCopyAllSuccess] = useState(false);
```

Add a `handleNotifyAll` callback:
```typescript
const handleNotifyAll = useCallback(() => {
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.set("intent", "notify-all");
  fetcher.submit(fd, { method: "POST" });
  setNotifyAllModalOpen(false);
}, [fetcher]);
```

Add a `handleCopyAllEmails` callback (similar to existing `handleCopyEmails` but uses `notifyAllResult`).

### 3. Frontend — useEffect for notify-all result

In the existing useEffect that checks `fetcher.data` for `"notify-zip"` action, add handling for `"notify-all"`:
```typescript
if (fetcher.data.action === "notify-all") {
  const data = fetcher.data as { ... };
  setNotifyAllResult({ emails: data.emails, count: data.count, zipBreakdown: data.zipBreakdown });
  setNotifyAllResultModalOpen(true);
}
```

### 4. Frontend — "Notify All" button in the ZIP notify card

In the existing "Notify Waiting Customers by ZIP Code" card (the one that shows per-ZIP rows), add a "Notify All Customers" button:
- Place it in the card header area, in the same BlockStack as the title/description, but after the Divider — or better yet, add it as an InlineStack with the title so the button is on the right side of the card header
- Button text: `Notify All ${stats.waiting} Customers`
- Button variant: `"primary"`
- Button icon: `EmailIcon`
- onClick: `() => setNotifyAllModalOpen(true)`
- loading: `fetcher.state !== "idle"`
- Disabled if `stats.waiting === 0`

### 5. Frontend — Confirmation Modal

Add a new Modal for confirming the "Notify All" action:
```tsx
<Modal
  open={notifyAllModalOpen}
  onClose={() => setNotifyAllModalOpen(false)}
  title="Notify All Waiting Customers"
  primaryAction={{
    content: `Notify All ${stats.waiting} Customers`,
    onAction: handleNotifyAll,
    tone: "success" as any,
    loading: fetcher.state !== "idle",
  }}
  secondaryActions={[{ content: "Cancel", onAction: () => setNotifyAllModalOpen(false) }]}
>
  <Modal.Section>
    <BlockStack gap="400">
      <Banner tone="warning">
        This will mark all {stats.waiting} waiting customers across {zipWaitingCounts.length} ZIP code{zipWaitingCounts.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} as notified. This action cannot be undone.
      </Banner>
      <Text as="p">
        After confirming, you'll receive all customer email addresses so you can contact them through your preferred email service.
      </Text>
      <BlockStack gap="200">
        <Text as="h3" variant="headingSm">ZIP Code Breakdown:</Text>
        {zipWaitingCounts.map(({ zipCode, count }) => (
          <InlineStack key={zipCode} gap="200">
            <Text as="span" fontWeight="bold">{zipCode}</Text>
            <Text as="span" tone="subdued">{count} customer{count === 1 ? "" : "s"}</Text>
          </InlineStack>
        ))}
      </BlockStack>
    </BlockStack>
  </Modal.Section>
</Modal>
```

### 6. Frontend — Result Modal

Add a result modal for "Notify All" (similar to the existing notify result modal but for all ZIPs):
```tsx
<Modal
  open={notifyAllResultModalOpen}
  onClose={() => { setNotifyAllResultModalOpen(false); setCopyAllSuccess(false); }}
  title="All Waiting Customers Notified"
  primaryAction={{
    content: copyAllSuccess ? "Copied!" : "Copy All Emails",
    onAction: handleCopyAllEmails,
    disabled: !notifyAllResult || notifyAllResult.emails.length === 0,
  }}
  secondaryActions={
    notifyAllResult && notifyAllResult.emails.length > 0 && notifyAllResult.emails.length <= 50
      ? [
          {
            content: "Open in Email Client",
            url: `mailto:${notifyAllResult.emails.join(",")}?subject=${encodeURIComponent("Great news! We now deliver to your area")}&body=${encodeURIComponent("Hi!\n\nWe wanted to let you know that we now deliver to your area.\n\nThank you for your patience!")}`,
            external: true,
          },
          { content: "Close", onAction: () => { setNotifyAllResultModalOpen(false); setCopyAllSuccess(false); } },
        ]
      : [{ content: "Close", onAction: () => { setNotifyAllResultModalOpen(false); setCopyAllSuccess(false); } }]
  }
>
  <Modal.Section>
    <BlockStack gap="400">
      {notifyAllResult && notifyAllResult.count > 0 ? (
        <>
          <Banner tone="success">
            Successfully notified {notifyAllResult.count} customer{notifyAllResult.count === 1 ? "" : "s"} across {notifyAllResult.zipBreakdown.length} ZIP code{notifyAllResult.zipBreakdown.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}.
          </Banner>
          <BlockStack gap="200">
            <Text as="h3" variant="headingSm">Breakdown by ZIP Code:</Text>
            {notifyAllResult.zipBreakdown.map(({ zipCode, count }) => (
              <InlineStack key={zipCode} gap="200">
                <Text as="span" fontWeight="bold">{zipCode}</Text>
                <Text as="span" tone="subdued">{count} notified</Text>
              </InlineStack>
            ))}
          </BlockStack>
          <Text as="p">
            Copy these email addresses and paste them into your preferred email service to contact all notified customers.
          </Text>
          <TextField
            label="All Customer Emails"
            value={notifyAllResult.emails.join(", ")}
            onChange={() => {}}
            multiline={4}
            autoComplete="off"
            readOnly
          />
          {notifyAllResult.emails.length > 50 && (
            <Banner tone="info">
              Too many emails for the "Open in Email Client" option. Please copy and paste the emails into your email service instead.
            </Banner>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <Banner tone="info">
          No customers with "Waiting" status found. They may have already been notified.
        </Banner>
      )}
    </BlockStack>
  </Modal.Section>
</Modal>
```

### 7. Toast handling

In the existing useEffect that handles toast messages, add a case for `"notify-all"`:
- Do NOT show a toast for `"notify-all"` since the result modal handles the feedback

### Rules:
- Use ONLY Polaris v13 components
- Maintain existing code patterns exactly
- Do NOT modify any existing functionality
- Run `npm run typecheck` after making changes and fix ALL TypeScript errors
- The file is at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`

## Summary of Changes

**File modified:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`

### Backend — `notify-all` action intent (lines 184-213)
- Added after the existing `notify-zip` block
- Plan-gates to Pro/Ultimate (same check as `notify-zip`)
- Fetches all `waiting` entries for the shop with `id`, `email`, and `zipCode` fields
- Returns early with empty arrays if no waiting entries exist
- Bulk-updates all waiting entries to `"notified"` in a single `updateMany` call
- Builds a `zipBreakdown` array from a `Map` aggregation
- Returns `{ action: "notify-all", emails, count, zipBreakdown }`

### Frontend — New state variables (4 new)
- `notifyAllModalOpen` — controls the confirmation modal
- `notifyAllResultModalOpen` — controls the result modal
- `notifyAllResult` — typed object holding emails, count, and zipBreakdown
- `copyAllSuccess` — copy-to-clipboard feedback state

### Frontend — New callbacks
- `handleNotifyAll` — submits the `notify-all` form and closes the confirmation modal
- `handleCopyAllEmails` — copies all emails to clipboard with 2-second success feedback

### Frontend — useEffect update
- Extended the existing `fetcher.data` effect to handle both `"notify-zip"` and `"notify-all"` in a single `if/else if` block. No toast is shown for `"notify-all"` since the result modal provides feedback.

### Frontend — "Notify All" button in card header
- Replaced the plain `BlockStack` card header with an `InlineStack` (space-between) so the title/description stays left and the new "Notify All N Customers" primary button sits right
- Button is disabled when `stats.waiting === 0` and shows loading state while the fetcher is active

### Frontend — Two new Modals
1. **Confirmation modal** (`notifyAllModalOpen`) — shows a warning Banner with total count and per-ZIP breakdown before the merchant confirms
2. **Result modal** (`notifyAllResultModalOpen`) — shows a success Banner, per-ZIP breakdown, a read-only email list TextField, a "Copy All Emails" primary action, and a conditional "Open in Email Client" secondary action (suppressed when email count exceeds 50)

### Test Steps
1. Open the Waitlist page on a Pro or Ultimate plan with at least one `waiting` entry
2. Verify the "Notify Waiting Customers by ZIP Code" card header now shows the "Notify All N Customers" button on the right
3. Click the button — the confirmation modal appears showing the warning Banner and ZIP breakdown
4. Click "Notify All N Customers" in the modal — the result modal appears with the emails and breakdown
5. Verify "Copy All Emails" copies to clipboard; verify "Open in Email Client" appears only when <=50 emails
6. On a Free/Starter plan, verify the button still appears in the card but clicking it returns an error (plan gate enforced on the server)
